QMapShack Windows build dependencies
==================================

QMapShack is licensed under the GNU GPL version 3 or later; see 1LICENSE.txt.
Sources: https://github.com/Maproom/qmapshack and this build's linked source tag.

This build uses Qt 6 (MSVC 2022), the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, Routino,
and one matching GISInternals GDAL/PROJ/JPEG distribution. The exact GISInternals
package, download hashes, and copied runtime modules are recorded under
licenses/gisinternals/. Original vendor license files are preserved there,
including the separate ECW and MrSID terms. LICENSE_Gisinternals.txt preserves
the GISInternals notice already provided by the QMapShack repository.

ECW / ERDAS SDK ownership notice
------------------------------
This application supports the ECW data format and ECWP compression protocols.
Portions of this computer program are Copyright 2007-2013 Intergraph
Corporation. All rights reserved. Creating compressed files using ECW
technology is protected by one or more of U.S. Patent No. 6,201,897,
No. 6,442,298 and No. 6,633,688.

The ECW runtime supports desktop decoding. See
licenses/gisinternals/ECW5License.rtf for the supplied SDK terms.

MrSID
-----
The MrSID decoder and its original license are supplied by GISInternals.
See licenses/gisinternals/MRSIDLicense.rtf.

Other bundled components
------------------------
Qt: https://www.qt.io/licensing/
GDAL: https://gdal.org/
PROJ: https://proj.org/
Routino: https://www.routino.org/
JPEG: https://www.ijg.org/
Qt MySQL driver: https://github.com/thecodemonkey86/qt_mysql_driver/

The GISInternals runtime also includes dependencies used by raster plugins
(including KEA/HDF5, PDF/Poppler, WebP, PNG, JPEG, TIFF, SQLite, zlib and
OpenSSL). Preserve the original GISInternals and component license notices
when redistributing this package. The general GISInternals notice does not
replace the separate proprietary SDK license terms.
